title: Agents list view helpers for cards and score tables

claims.text: scoreTable renders agent, seat model, effort, mode, memory arm, runs, successes, unknown costs and mean cost and duration per score group.
agentCard builds an identity heading, full agent id, version, display name, workflow, language, status, allowed seats and compare control.
measurement returns Not measured for null or undefined values and otherwise formats the number with formatMeasurement.

decision.rule: Change here when agents list card layout, score table columns or measurement formatting needs to change.
decision.failure: A score table drops a seat column, a card loses its identity heading, or a missing value renders as zero instead of Not measured.

questions.q: Where does scoreTable render mean cost and mean duration per agent seat?
Where should I change how agentCard renders identity, version and allowed seats?
Where can I debug a compare control that stays disabled on collision?
